adaptations.summary: Upstream artifact-root paths (`revision-master.db`, `revision-master/scripts/...`) moved to ResearchSpec subflow layout (`work/review-response/review-response.db`, `skills/review-response/scripts/...`, `views/...`).
adaptations.evidence: scripts/gate_and_render_workspace.py: `--instance-root <INSTANCE_ROOT>` replaces upstream `--artifact-root`; all view paths now resolve under instance-root views/.

adaptations.summary: Upstream `assets/schema/revision-master-schema.yaml` published as `assets/schema/review-response-schema.yaml` with internal table-name and key renames aligned with the Skill identifier change.
adaptations.evidence: skills/review-response/assets/schema/review-response-schema.yaml (32008 bytes vs upstream 31541 bytes; net +467 bytes for identifier rename and section additions).

adaptations.summary: Upstream `conda run --no-capture-output -n DataProcessing python -u ...` invocation template removed; third-party dependency section rewritten to declare ResearchSpec does not auto-install and structured blocking errors are returned when PyYAML or Jinja2 is missing.

adaptations.summary: Stage 3 coverage requirements (primary/supporting/duplicate_filtered span roles, hard 30% / soft 50% thresholds, character-level coverage computation) declared as canonical Stage 3 outputs in the upstream SKILL.md and references/stage-3-comment-atomization.md; the ResearchSpec adaptation restates them with ResearchSpec vocabulary.
adaptations.evidence: Comparison shows the upstream text already contained these thresholds; adaptation is editorial rename + verbatim carry-over with ResearchSpec nomenclature.
